item.title: CENTCOM Conducts Airstrikes Against Iran-Backed Houthi Missile Storage and Command/Control Facilities in Yemen
item.description: U.S. Central Command forces conducted precision airstrikes against Houthi facilities in Sana'a, Yemen, and shot down multiple one-way attack UAVs and an anti-ship cruise missile over the Red Sea.

item.title: U.S. Forces Complete Another Round of Strikes Against Iran
item.description: CENTCOM forces completed an additional round of strikes to degrade Iran's ability to attack commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Commercial Vessels Flow Through Open Strait of Hormuz
